package q3format

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto"
	stdhex "encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-core/evmroot"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-core/handoff"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-core/rootchain/consensus/storage"
	rctypes "github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-core/rootchain/consensus/types"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-go-base/types"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-go-base/types/hex"
)

// Emits the Go side of the Rust conformance vectors (ureth C2a): `Q3_EMIT_RUST_VECTORS=/path/out.json go test ./q3format -run TestEmitRustVectors`.
// Every envelope is classified by the production Go verifier; the Rust verifier must reach the same class from the bytes alone.

type rustClaim struct {
	Epoch, Start uint64
	BodyID       string
	CommitID     string
	PriorVersion uint64
	PriorID      string
}

type rustExpect struct {
	Epoch, Start, Version, Scheme uint64
	BodyID, CommitID, AnchorID    string
	ConfigIdentity                string
	AnchorEpoch, AnchorRound      uint64
}

type rustCase struct {
	Name     string      `json:"name"`
	Envelope string      `json:"envelope"`
	Want     string      `json:"want"` // "" = accepted
	Expect   *rustExpect `json:"expect,omitempty"`
	Detail   string      `json:"detail,omitempty"`
	After    string      `json:"after,omitempty"` // hex of an accepted envelope applied to the genesis history before this one
}

func hx(b []byte) string { return stdhex.EncodeToString(b) }

func claimItems(c Claim) []any { return c.items() }

// wireEnvelope encodes without Encode's decode-validation, so that bodies Go itself refuses can still be put on the wire.
func wireEnvelope(e Envelope) []byte {
	trans := make([]any, len(e.Transitions))
	for i, t := range e.Transitions {
		trans[i] = t
	}
	links := make([]any, len(e.Links))
	for i, l := range e.Links {
		links[i] = []any{l.Body.Encode(), l.Claim.items(), evidenceItems(l.Evidence), l.Proof, receiptItems(l.Receipts)}
	}
	var block any
	if len(e.BlockID) != 0 {
		block = e.BlockID
	}
	return enc(envelopeDomain, uint64(EnvelopeVersion), e.RootInput, trans, e.TargetParent, block, links)
}

var sentinels = []struct {
	name string
	err  error
}{
	{"ErrConflict", ErrConflict}, {"ErrActivation", ErrActivation}, {"ErrBinding", ErrBinding}, {"ErrNetwork", ErrNetwork}, {"ErrGenesis", ErrGenesis},
	{"ErrPrior", ErrPrior}, {"ErrMissingHistory", ErrMissingHistory}, {"ErrHistory", ErrHistory}, {"ErrBody", ErrBody},
	{"ErrConfig", ErrConfig}, {"ErrScheme", ErrScheme}, {"ErrReceiptMissing", ErrReceiptMissing}, {"ErrReceiptDuplicate", ErrReceiptDuplicate},
	{"ErrReceiptUnknown", ErrReceiptUnknown}, {"ErrReceiptSignature", ErrReceiptSignature}, {"ErrReceiptContext", ErrReceiptContext},
	{"ErrEnvelope", ErrEnvelope}, {"ErrTooLarge", ErrTooLarge}, {"ErrFormat", ErrFormat}, {"ErrVersion", ErrVersion},
}

// classify names the most specific sentinel the error matches. Order matters where Go joins several: the first match in the list wins
// except that ErrActivation (the old-committee refusal) is preferred over the verifier's own wrapped errors.
func classify(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return ""
	}
	for _, s := range sentinels {
		if errors.Is(err, s.err) {
			return s.name
		}
	}
	return "other: " + err.Error()
}

// proofWith is commitProof with the phase and ordered round of the last control step and the commit round chosen by the caller, for the
// clauses a consistent proof cannot reach through commitProof's own fixed values.
func proofWith(t *testing.T, tb *types.RootTrustBaseV1, s signers, rec evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord, phase string, finalRound, commitRound uint64, signedBy ...string) handoff.OldCommitProof {
	t.Helper()
	net := tb.NetworkID
	parent, err := storage.NewGenesisBlock(net, crypto.SHA256, storage.ProfileHandoff)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	zero := make([]byte, 32)
	steps := []struct {
		round       uint64
		kind, phase string
		frozen, tr  []byte
	}{{2, "prepare", "prepared", zero, zero}, {3, "freeze", "frozen", rec.FrozenID, zero}, {finalRound, rec.Kind, phase, rec.FrozenID, rec.SuccessorTRHash}}
	for _, st := range steps {
		ordered := rec
		ordered.OrderedRound, ordered.Kind, ordered.FrozenID, ordered.SuccessorTRHash = st.round, st.kind, st.frozen, st.tr
		previous := parent.ShardState.Control
		parent.ShardState.Control = &evmroot.ControlState{Network: rec.Network, Epoch: rec.Epoch, PredecessorBodyID: rec.PredecessorBodyID,
			Attempt: rec.Attempt, Phase: st.phase, OrderedRound: st.round, RecordBytes: ordered.Bytes(), PreviousDigest: previous.Digest()}
	}
	control := *parent.ShardState.Control
	tree, _, err := parent.ShardState.UnicityTree(crypto.SHA256)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	path, err := tree.Certificate(evmroot.D4ControlPartition)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	stamp := types.NewTimestamp()
	vote := &rctypes.RoundInfo{Version: 1, RoundNumber: commitRound + 1, Epoch: rec.Epoch, Timestamp: stamp, ParentRoundNumber: commitRound, CurrentRootHash: tree.RootHash()}
	voteHash, err := vote.Hash(crypto.SHA256)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	seal := &types.UnicitySeal{Version: 1, NetworkID: net, RootChainRoundNumber: commitRound, Epoch: rec.Epoch, Timestamp: stamp, Hash: tree.RootHash(), PreviousHash: voteHash}
	signed, err := seal.SigBytes()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	qc := &rctypes.QuorumCert{VoteInfo: vote, LedgerCommitInfo: seal, Signatures: map[string]hex.Bytes{}}
	for _, id := range signedBy {
		sig, err := s[id].SignBytes(signed)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		qc.Signatures[id] = sig
	}
	return handoff.OldCommitProof{Profile: evmroot.D4Profile, Record: rec, Control: control, ControlPath: path, CommitQC: qc}
}

// emitWorld classifies every case of one world (one random genesis committee) with the production verifier. A world that is not
// full carries only the first-link control, for the genesis-start cases.
func emitWorld(t *testing.T, w *world, full bool) ([]rustCase, []byte, []byte) {
	genesis := w.h.entries[0].tb
	genesisBytes, err := types.Cbor.Marshal(genesis)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	genesisID, err := genesis.Hash(crypto.SHA256)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	envelopeFor := func(h *History, l Link) (Envelope, bool) {
		// the claim is what the production verifier derives when it accepts the link, else the claim a sender would make from the proof
		if next, err := h.WithV3(l); err == nil {
			l.Claim = next.Tip().claim()
			return Envelope{RootInput: []byte{1, 1, 1, 1}, Transitions: [][]byte{[]byte("t1")}, TargetParent: fill(0x88), Links: []Link{l}}, true
		}
		var rec evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord
		if p, err := decodeProof(l.Proof); err == nil {
			rec = p.Record
		}
		tip := h.Tip()
		l.Claim = Claim{Epoch: l.Body.Epoch, Start: rec.ActivationRound, BodyID: l.Body.Identity(), CommitID: [32]byte(rec.ID()), PriorVersion: tip.version, PriorID: tip.bodyID}
		return Envelope{RootInput: []byte{1, 1, 1, 1}, Transitions: [][]byte{[]byte("t1")}, TargetParent: fill(0x88), Links: []Link{l}}, false
	}
	classifyEnv := func(h *History, raw []byte) (string, *History) {
		e, err := DecodeEnvelope(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return classify(err), nil
		}
		next, err := h.VerifyEnvelope(e)
		return classify(err), next
	}

	var cases []rustCase
	add := func(name string, h *History, e Envelope, detail string) {
		raw := wireEnvelope(e)
		want, next := classifyEnv(h, raw)
		c := rustCase{Name: name, Envelope: hx(raw), Want: want, Detail: detail}
		if want == "" {
			tip := next.Tip()
			ce, _ := tip.Config()
			ep, rd := tip.Anchor()
			c.Expect = &rustExpect{Epoch: tip.epoch, Start: tip.start, Version: tip.version, Scheme: tip.scheme, BodyID: hx(tip.bodyID[:]), CommitID: hx(tip.commitID[:]),
				AnchorID: hx(tip.anchorID[:]), ConfigIdentity: hx(func() []byte { i := ce.Identity(); return i[:] }()), AnchorEpoch: ep, AnchorRound: rd}
		}
		cases = append(cases, c)
	}

	// acceptance controls
	pos := w.link(spec{})
	e, ok := envelopeFor(w.h, pos)
	require.True(t, ok || !full, "the full world's control is accepted; a late genesis world may refuse it")
	add("positive: first V3 link over the genesis", w.h, e, "")
	if !full {
		return cases, genesisBytes, genesisID
	}
	min := w.link(spec{activate: 20})
	e, ok = envelopeFor(w.h, min)
	require.True(t, ok)
	add("positive: A* equal to A_min", w.h, e, "")

	other := func(b byte) []byte { return fill(b) }
	type neg struct {
		name string
		sp   spec
	}
	for _, n := range []neg{
		{"uncommitted freeze record", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.Kind = "freeze" }}},
		{"quorum by weight is short", spec{signedBy: []string{"a", "b"}}},
		{"unknown signers", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			s := newSigners(t, "a", "b", "c")
			signed, err := p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.SigBytes()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			for id, sg := range s {
				p.CommitQC.Signatures[id], err = sg.SignBytes(signed)
				require.NoError(t, err)
			}
		}}},
		{"forged control leaf", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.PreviousDigest = other(1) }}},
		{"record epoch", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.Epoch = 2 }}},
		{"record network", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.Network = 6 }}},
		{"another body", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.NextBodyID = other(1) }}},
		{"another predecessor", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) {
			b.ChangeRecordHash = evmroot.D4CandidateContextHash(b.Network, other(1), 3, fill(0x44), b.EarliestActivation)
		}, record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) {
			r.PredecessorBodyID = other(1)
			r.FrozenID = evmroot.D4FrozenID(r.NextBodyID, fill(0x55), fill(0x66), fill(0x44), 3, other(1))
		}}},
		{"A* before A_min", spec{activate: 19}},
		{"another frozen id", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.FrozenID = other(1) }}},
		{"another summary", spec{evidence: func(e *Evidence) { e.Summary = other(1) }}},
		{"another parent", spec{evidence: func(e *Evidence) { e.FrozenParent = other(1) }}},
		{"another candidate", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) {
			b.ChangeRecordHash = evmroot.D4CandidateContextHash(b.Network, b.PredecessorHash, 3, other(1), b.EarliestActivation)
		}}},
		{"another attempt", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) {
			b.ChangeRecordHash = evmroot.D4CandidateContextHash(b.Network, func() []byte { b := w.h.Tip().bodyID; return b[:] }(), 4, fill(0x44), b.EarliestActivation)
		}}},
		{"short candidate", spec{evidence: func(e *Evidence) { e.CandidateDigest = e.CandidateDigest[:31] }}},
		{"no summary", spec{evidence: func(e *Evidence) { e.Summary = nil }}},
		{"network", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Network, b.Config = 6, Q3Config(6, b.Config.Genesis) }}},
		{"tuple network", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Config = Q3Config(6, b.Config.Genesis) }}},
		{"genesis", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Config.Genesis = arr32(9) }}},
		{"predecessor", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.PredecessorHash = fill(1) }}},
		{"epoch gap", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Epoch = 3 }}},
		{"epoch repeated", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Epoch = 1 }}},
		{"invalid body threshold", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.RootThreshold = 8 }}},
		{"weight above the cap", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Members[0].Weight = evmroot.MaxMemberWeight + 1 }}},
		{"duplicate key", spec{body: func(b *BodyV3) { b.Members[1].ConsensusKey = b.Members[0].ConsensusKey }}},
		{"missing receipt", spec{receipts: func(r []Receipt) []Receipt { return r[:3] }}},
		{"duplicate receipt", spec{receipts: func(r []Receipt) []Receipt { return append(r, r[0]) }}},
		{"unknown receipt signer", spec{receipts: func(r []Receipt) []Receipt { r[0].NodeID = "zz"; return r }}},
		{"forged receipt signature", spec{receipts: func(r []Receipt) []Receipt { r[1].Signature = append([]byte(nil), r[0].Signature...); return r }}},
	} {
		l := w.link(n.sp)
		e, _ := envelopeFor(w.h, l)
		add("negative: "+n.name, w.h, e, "")
	}

	// the commit proof, clause by clause: each case changes one thing and re-signs what it must so that only that clause can refuse
	resign := func(qc *rctypes.QuorumCert, ids ...string) {
		h, err := qc.VoteInfo.Hash(crypto.SHA256)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		qc.LedgerCommitInfo.PreviousHash = h
		signed, err := qc.LedgerCommitInfo.SigBytes()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		qc.Signatures = map[string]hex.Bytes{}
		for _, id := range ids {
			qc.Signatures[id], err = w.signers[1][id].SignBytes(signed)
			require.NoError(t, err)
		}
	}
	abc := []string{"a", "b", "c"}
	optional := func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) *rctypes.QuorumCert {
		v := *p.CommitQC.VoteInfo
		v.RoundNumber, v.ParentRoundNumber = p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.RootChainRoundNumber, p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.RootChainRoundNumber-1
		seal := *p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo
		seal.Signatures = nil
		qc := &rctypes.QuorumCert{VoteInfo: &v, LedgerCommitInfo: &seal}
		resign(qc, abc...)
		return qc
	}
	for _, n := range []neg{
		{"optional certificate, valid", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.OptionalQC = optional(p) }}},
		{"optional certificate, wrong round", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			q.VoteInfo.RoundNumber, q.VoteInfo.ParentRoundNumber = 3, 2
			resign(q, abc...)
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"optional certificate, wrong epoch", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			q.VoteInfo.Epoch = 2
			resign(q, abc...)
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"optional certificate, wrong timestamp", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			q.VoteInfo.Timestamp++
			resign(q, abc...)
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"optional certificate, wrong root", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			q.VoteInfo.CurrentRootHash = other(3)
			resign(q, abc...)
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"optional certificate, short of quorum", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			resign(q, "a", "b")
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"optional certificate, no vote info", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			q.VoteInfo = nil
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"optional certificate, no commit info", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			q := optional(p)
			q.LedgerCommitInfo = nil
			p.OptionalQC = q
		}}},
		{"commit certificate rounds: vote round not c+1", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.RoundNumber = 6; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate rounds: parent not c", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.ParentRoundNumber = 3; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate rounds: c before the ordered round", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.RootChainRoundNumber = 3
			p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.RoundNumber, p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.ParentRoundNumber = 4, 3
			resign(p.CommitQC, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate rounds: zero commit round", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.RootChainRoundNumber = 0
			p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.RoundNumber, p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.ParentRoundNumber = 1, 0
			resign(p.CommitQC, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: vote epoch", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.Epoch = 2; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate: seal network", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.NetworkID = 6; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate: seal epoch", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.Epoch = 2; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate: seal later than the vote", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.Timestamp++; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate: timestamps before the genesis time", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.Timestamp, p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.Timestamp = 1000, 1000
			resign(p.CommitQC, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: zero timestamps", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.Timestamp, p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.Timestamp = 0, 0
			resign(p.CommitQC, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: state root", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.Hash = other(3)
			resign(p.CommitQC, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: vote root", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.CurrentRootHash = other(3)
			resign(p.CommitQC, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: previous hash is not the vote info hash", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.PreviousHash = other(3)
			signed, err := p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo.SigBytes()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			for _, id := range abc {
				p.CommitQC.Signatures[id], err = w.signers[1][id].SignBytes(signed)
				require.NoError(t, err)
			}
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: version", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.VoteInfo.Version = 2; resign(p.CommitQC, abc...) }}},
		{"commit certificate: unsigned", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.Signatures = map[string]hex.Bytes{} }}},
		{"commit certificate: one forged signature beside a quorum", spec{signedBy: []string{"a", "b", "c", "d"}, proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.CommitQC.Signatures["d"] = append(hex.Bytes(nil), p.CommitQC.Signatures["a"]...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate: strictly all four valid", spec{signedBy: []string{"a", "b", "c", "d"}}},
		{"commit certificate: nil vote info", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.VoteInfo = nil }}},
		{"commit certificate: nil commit info", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo = nil }}},
		{"commit certificate: absent", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.CommitQC = nil }}},
		{"control path: absent", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.ControlPath = nil }}},
		{"control path: partition", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.ControlPath.Partition = 5 }}},
		{"control path: version", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.ControlPath.Version = 2 }}},
		{"control path: a step for the control partition", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.ControlPath.HashSteps = []*types.PathItem{{Key: evmroot.D4ControlPartition, Hash: other(1)}}
		}}},
		{"control path: a step that changes the root", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.ControlPath.HashSteps = []*types.PathItem{{Key: 7, Hash: other(1)}}
		}}},
		{"control: phase", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.Phase = "frozen" }}},
		{"control: network", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.Network = 6 }}},
		{"control: epoch", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.Epoch = 2 }}},
		{"control: attempt", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.Attempt = 4 }}},
		{"control: ordered round", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.OrderedRound = 3 }}},
		{"control: predecessor", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.PredecessorBodyID = other(1) }}},
		{"control: record bytes", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			p.Control.RecordBytes = append(append([]byte(nil), p.Control.RecordBytes...), 0)
		}}},
		{"control: short previous digest", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.PreviousDigest = p.Control.PreviousDigest[:31] }}},
		{"control: frozen parent changes the leaf", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Control.FrozenParent = other(1) }}},
		{"proof profile", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) { p.Profile = 1 }}},
		{"record: kind freeze under a committed control phase", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			rec := p.Record
			rec.Kind = "freeze"
			*p = proofWith(t, w.h.Tip().tb, w.signers[1], rec, "committed", 4, 4, abc...)
		}}},
		{"record: ordered round zero", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			rec := p.Record
			rec.OrderedRound = 0
			*p = proofWith(t, w.h.Tip().tb, w.signers[1], rec, "committed", 0, 4, abc...)
		}}},
		{"record: activation before the ordered round", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			rec := p.Record
			rec.ActivationRound = 3
			*p = proofWith(t, w.h.Tip().tb, w.signers[1], rec, "committed", 4, 4, abc...)
		}}},
		{"acceptance control for the rebuilt proof", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			*p = proofWith(t, w.h.Tip().tb, w.signers[1], p.Record, "committed", 4, 4, abc...)
		}}},
		{"commit certificate rounds: commit round is MaxUint64", spec{proof: func(p *handoff.OldCommitProof) {
			*p = proofWith(t, w.h.Tip().tb, w.signers[1], p.Record, "committed", 4, ^uint64(0), abc...)
		}}},
		{"record: pipeline depth", spec{aMin: 5, activate: 6}},
		{"record: zero frozen id", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.FrozenID = make([]byte, 32) }}},
		{"record: zero successor TR", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.SuccessorTRHash = make([]byte, 32) }}},
		{"record: short successor TR", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.SuccessorTRHash = make([]byte, 31) }}},
		{"record: attempt differs from the control leaf", spec{record: func(r *evmroot.OrderedHandoffRecord) { r.Attempt = 9 }}},
	} {
		l := w.link(n.sp)
		e, _ := envelopeFor(w.h, l)
		add("proof: "+n.name, w.h, e, "")
	}

	// the claim must equal the derived activation, field for field
	for name, mut := range map[string]func(*Claim){
		"claim epoch":         func(c *Claim) { c.Epoch++ },
		"claim start":         func(c *Claim) { c.Start++ },
		"claim body":          func(c *Claim) { c.BodyID[0] ^= 1 },
		"claim commit id":     func(c *Claim) { c.CommitID[0] ^= 1 },
		"claim prior version": func(c *Claim) { c.PriorVersion = 2 },
		"claim prior id":      func(c *Claim) { c.PriorID[0] ^= 1 },
	} {
		l := w.link(spec{})
		e, ok := envelopeFor(w.h, l)
		require.True(t, ok)
		mut(&e.Links[0].Claim)
		add("negative: "+name, w.h, e, "")
	}

	// a second V3 link has no scheme-2 commit verifier: ErrScheme, never scheme 1
	l1 := w.link(spec{})
	h1, err := w.h.WithV3(l1)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	genesisHistory := w.h
	w.h = h1
	l2 := w.link(spec{aMin: 21, activate: 40, signedBy: []string{"n1", "n2"}})
	w.h = genesisHistory
	e1, _ := envelopeFor(w.h, l1)
	e1.Links[0].Claim = h1.Tip().claim()
	// a two-link envelope: the first accepted, the second refused with ErrScheme
	l2.Claim = Claim{Epoch: 3, Start: 40}
	two := Envelope{RootInput: []byte{1, 1, 1, 1}, Transitions: [][]byte{[]byte("t1")}, TargetParent: fill(0x88), Links: []Link{e1.Links[0], l2}}
	add("negative: second V3 link is scheme 2 and has no verifier", w.h, two, "")

	// missing history: only the second link is supplied against the genesis-only history
	only2 := Envelope{RootInput: []byte{1, 1, 1, 1}, Transitions: [][]byte{[]byte("t1")}, TargetParent: fill(0x88), Links: []Link{l2}}
	add("negative: missing ancestor (only epoch 3 supplied)", w.h, only2, "")

	// a retained reference: verified entry presented again on the extended history is accepted; presented differently, it conflicts
	rawRef := wireEnvelope(e1)
	_, next := classifyEnv(w.h, rawRef)
	require.NotNil(t, next)
	want, _ := classifyEnv(next, rawRef)
	cases = append(cases, rustCase{Name: "retained reference to an already verified link", Envelope: hx(rawRef), Want: want, After: hx(rawRef), Detail: "verify against the history already extended by the same envelope"})
	conf := e1
	conf.Links = []Link{e1.Links[0]}
	conf.Links[0].Claim.Start++
	rawConf := wireEnvelope(conf)
	wantC, _ := classifyEnv(next, rawConf)
	cases = append(cases, rustCase{Name: "retained reference differing from the verified entry", Envelope: hx(rawConf), Want: wantC, After: hx(rawRef), Detail: "verify against the history already extended by the retained envelope"})

	// a retained link authenticates what it supplies: nothing may differ from the verified entry even though the claim matches
	retainedCase := func(name string, mutate func(l *Link)) {
		l := e1.Links[0]
		l.Receipts = append([]Receipt(nil), l.Receipts...)
		l.Proof = append([]byte(nil), l.Proof...)
		mutate(&l)
		raw := wireEnvelope(Envelope{RootInput: []byte{1, 1, 1, 1}, Transitions: [][]byte{[]byte("t1")}, TargetParent: fill(0x88), Links: []Link{l}})
		got, _ := classifyEnv(next, raw)
		cases = append(cases, rustCase{Name: "retained: " + name, Envelope: hx(raw), Want: got, After: hx(rawRef), Detail: "verify against the history already extended by the retained envelope"})
	}
	retainedCase("body differs, claim unchanged", func(l *Link) { l.Body.StateSummary = fill(0x23) })
	retainedCase("commit proof signature forged, record unchanged", func(l *Link) {
		p, err := decodeProof(l.Proof)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		forged := append(hex.Bytes(nil), p.CommitQC.Signatures["a"]...)
		forged[10] ^= 1
		p.CommitQC.Signatures["a"] = forged
		l.Proof, err = types.Cbor.Marshal(p)
		require.NoError(t, err)
	})
	retainedCase("evidence differs", func(l *Link) { l.Evidence.Summary = fill(0x24) })
	retainedCase("receipt signature forged", func(l *Link) { l.Receipts[1].Signature = append([]byte(nil), l.Receipts[0].Signature...) })
	retainedCase("receipts missing", func(l *Link) { l.Receipts = l.Receipts[:3] })
	retainedCase("proof absent", func(l *Link) { l.Proof = nil })
	retainedCase("acceptance control: nothing differs", func(l *Link) {})

	// the embedded seal's own signature map is typed like go-base's SignatureMap: {"a": 1} fails the typed proof decode
	patched := func(l Link) Link {
		p, err := decodeProof(l.Proof)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		seal, err := types.Cbor.Marshal(p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, byte(0xf6), seal[len(seal)-1], "the embedded seal signatures are null")
		patchedSeal := append(append([]byte(nil), seal[:len(seal)-1]...), 0xa1, 0x61, 0x61, 0x01)
		require.Equal(t, 1, bytes.Count(l.Proof, seal))
		l.Proof = bytes.Replace(l.Proof, seal, patchedSeal, 1)
		return l
	}
	lp := w.link(spec{})
	ep, _ := envelopeFor(w.h, lp)
	ep.Links[0] = patched(ep.Links[0])
	add("negative: embedded seal signature map is not (text, bytes)", w.h, ep, "")

	return cases, genesisBytes, genesisID
}

func TestEmitRustVectors(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("Q3_EMIT_RUST_VECTORS")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("set Q3_EMIT_RUST_VECTORS to emit the Rust conformance vectors")
	}
	var worlds []map[string]any
	// the genesis epoch starts at round 0 for the full list; the late worlds have A* = 25 against genesis starts 30, 25 and 24
	for _, ws := range []struct {
		name  string
		start uint64
		full  bool
	}{{"genesis-start-0", 0, true}, {"genesis-start-30", 30, false}, {"genesis-start-25", 25, false}, {"genesis-start-24", 24, false}} {
		cases, gen, id := emitWorld(t, newWorld(t, ws.start), ws.full)
		worlds = append(worlds, map[string]any{"name": ws.name, "genesisStart": ws.start, "genesisTrustBase": hx(gen), "genesisId": hx(id), "cases": cases})
		for _, c := range cases {
			t.Logf("%-16s %-70s -> %q", ws.name, c.Name, c.Want)
		}
	}
	doc := map[string]any{
		"note":    "Generated by bft-core q3format TestEmitRustVectors at the #407 head d36d3611; signers are random, so the file is generated once and committed.",
		"network": testNetwork,
		"worlds":  worlds,
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(out, append(b, '\n'), 0o644))
}
